title: Bitcoin holds near $86,000 as spot Bitcoin ETF inflows hit 11-month high of $999 million - The Economic Times
text:
Bitcoin traded near $86,000 after US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded nearly $999 million in single-day inflows, their strongest in 11 months. Institutional demand and short liquidations supported the rally, while analysts watched $89,000 as a potential trigger toward $100,000.
